name: lookup: no url lookup of the anchors
why: An event MusicBrainz links to the row's own Brucebase anchor is the row's, found with one request per 100 entries (probe 2026-10-24).

name: lookup: the name search's top hit on any date
why: A name-search hit counts only on the row's own date; the top hit of "1985-01-10: …" may be another show at that venue.

name: lookup: the store is never read
why: A second visit answers every row from the store (90 days, 7 for no event) with no request.

name: lookup: a failure stored as no event
why: A request that failed leaves its rows unanswered, shown as failed and asked again on a click; it is never stored.

name: lookup: the setting ignored
why: sa_bb_mb_event_lookup off: nothing is asked until the ▶ MB header button.

name: late write: the filter caches kept
why: docs/claude/filter-and-cache-invariants.md: a post-render cell write invalidates the filter result cache and re-runs an active filter.
grep: late answers reach an active filter

name: card: the glyph's source not registered
why: org/TODO.org Some enhancements f: hovering the found glyph shows the MusicBrainz event's card.
grep: found by its link: the event card

name: card: loaded under another key than the card reads
why: The card renders _MB_KINDS.event's own answer, so the load must use its cardInc (the _mbPop key).
grep: found by its link: the event card

name: card: no Brucebase block
why: The card says how the event was found and whether its Brucebase link is this entry's.

edits.find: return _MB_KINDS.event.card(t, false, repaint).replace(/<div class="mb-tt-foot">/, (f) => check + f);

name: finding: the anchor's other events ignored
why: An entry whose anchor MusicBrainz links from ANOTHER event is an ERROR, even when the matched event links nothing.
grep: ERROR for a link to another entry

name: finding: no re-stamp after the late answer
why: stampFindings() ran before the answers: without the per-row re-stamp nothing is ever flagged (late data, findings.md).
grep: ERROR for a link to another entry

name: finding: the tint setting ignored
why: sa_findings_tint_bb_mbev_link off: no tint, the menu row stays.

why: Each finding has its own switch.
